items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You were doing Dick Cavett’s television show. ... [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right. I was scared to death.

ctx.x: That’s true. But you know the thing about that that was so beautiful, you were doing the, with Bobby Rosengarden, you were doing the television show. What’s the boy’s name?

You were doing Dick Cavett’s television show. So they wanted a Fender sound, remember that? And this was years later now, many years later. And one day you were around Cranshaw, and Cran said, “What’s the matter?” And you said, “Man they want this thing here and I don’t know if I can get this thing.” And Cran says, “Come on over here and let me show you.”
